-- Recovery metadata is mutable; immutable identity/payload trigger is unchanged.
ALTER TABLE practice_student_evidence_outbox
    ADD COLUMN last_attempt_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    ADD COLUMN next_attempt_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    ADD COLUMN last_failure_code TEXT CHECK (last_failure_code IN (
        'EVIDENCE_PAYLOAD_INVALID', 'EVIDENCE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH',
        'EVIDENCE_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE', 'EVIDENCE_RECEIPT_MISMATCH',
        'EVIDENCE_DELIVERY_MARKER'));
CREATE INDEX practice_student_evidence_outbox_retry_idx
    ON practice_student_evidence_outbox (next_attempt_at, last_attempt_at, created_at, id)
    WHERE delivered_at IS NULL;
